Api.//: Backend base address. Left blank so a local build keeps using the compile-time default (10.0.2.2 on Android, localhost elsewhere). Set it to point a build at staging or production without rebuilding from source.

Map.//: TransitInfoAPI base address, used only to load the map page. The map reads that service directly and anonymously; everything else goes through Api:BaseUrl. Must be https — the Android manifest disallows cleartext, so TransitInfoAPI's http profile fails silently there.
